groups.saying_opens: أتاه رجلان في فتنة ابن الزبير
أن رجلا، أتى ابن عمر فقال

notes: «وزاد عثمان بن صالح عن ابن وهب» opens a second saying with its own isnad: stored as its own group (rule 4a); the names it shares with the first are written again
«أخبرني فلان» is an unnamed transmitter (the text gives no name)
the Quranic verses are quoted, not transmitters; Ibn Umar is the last link of both sayings
